scene: The ticking watch pops open, chiming three departure gates to distant districts.
picture: Side view along a misty stone transit platform. On the far left, a sleek hover metro hums with open doors. Left of centre, Granny holds her dog. At centre rests a two-seater flying scooter. Right of centre stands the smiling brass gent, while far right floats a striped passenger gondola drone.
shown: a sleek hover metro with open doors waiting far left along the track
a twin-propeller flying scooter resting on a launch pad at centre
a striped gondola suspended under a buzzing drone floating on the far right
